# The default ρ, decided by numbers — field v4.1

**Spike only**: nothing adopted, no default changed, no threshold or `RHO` touched.

The director's expectation, written before the run: *all three rates 1.1-1.3x, all healing within 250 steps; if so the default becomes 0.005.*

Beat 2 of Decision 22's claim A, measured before anything is built to do it. 400 ants, 3 seeds, D=20 T=80 W=3 w=4 ε=0. Settle **3000 steps** — twenty seconds at 150 steps/s — then an 11-cell bar (x = 30, y = 15..25) shuts across the road, then 12000 more.

BFS zone to zone: **45 moves** on open ground, **55** with the bar shut. Readings after the break are over trips completed AFTER it, ÷ 55 — so "healed" means the colony found a route as good as the new best, not that it got back to a number the new terrain no longer allows. Healed = first sample ≤ 1.6×.

| ρ | 4 s | 10 s | 20 s (= break) | trips before | trapped | +1000 | +12000 | healed at |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.005 | 2.31× | 4.01× | 1.70× | 4812 | 0 | 1.31× | 1.31× | 250 |
| 0.01 (current default) | 2.69× | 1.13× | 1.13× | 9077 | 15 | 1.09× | 1.09× | 250 |
| 0.02 | —× | 1.18× | 1.00× | 9454 | 0 | 1.52× | 1.47× | 250 |
